name: Minimalist Daily Habit & Goal Tracker (Canva + Printable PDF)
description:
Transform Your Daily Routine & Achieve Goals with Minimalist Discipline

Consistency is built on simple daily habits. The Minimalist Daily Habit & Goal Tracker is an aesthetic, science-backed daily productivity sheet designed to keep your routines structured without overwhelming you.

💎 What Is Included:

  • 7-Day Habit Tracker Grid: Dedicated checkboxes to measure consistency across key habits.
  • Morning & Evening Routine Architecture: Set your day up for focus and wind down smoothly.
  • Daily Priorities & Top 3 Tasks: Cut through noise and focus strictly on high-leverage outputs.
  • Hydration & Productivity Score: Simple visual trackers to check energy and wellness daily.
  • 1-Click Instant Canva Access: Customize fonts, colors, and layout in Canva Free or Pro!
  • Printable High-Res PDF: Crisp A4 ready for immediate home printing or desk binders.
  • Digital Planner Compatible: Works seamlessly in GoodNotes, Notability, and tablet note apps.

🛠️ How It Works:

  1. Instant download upon purchase.
  2. Open the Access-Your-Template.html file to access your template directly in Canva.
  3. Or directly print the included high-res PDF for immediate physical use!
